info.description: A marketing page that is mostly bespoke: a hero and a closing CTA that are editable here, with the sections between them built in the front end. Typed fields rather than a dynamic zone, because those middle sections are one-offs -- a tabbed panel, a theme picker, a comparison table -- and a component per single use buys nothing. Covers the pages under /features as well as the product pages whose middles are bespoke.
